case_title: VAN DER STERRE PETER VS LAMPLEY BRAD

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,825.00 FILED BY VAN DER STERRE PETER AS TO DEFENDANT LAMPLEY BRAD ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-16-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF VAN DER STERRE PETER IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT LAMPLEY BRAD STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
